Answer withheld

exit code 2

Verified, but the answer is
about the wrong thing, or
the right chunk is missing

div.style: color: rgb(74, 54, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

scripts/fetch_corpus.py
kept 0 docs, or HTTP 404/other

div.style: color: rgb(74, 54, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

error: cannot bind HOST:PORT
Address already in use
when running ethrag serve

span.p:
MCP client: failed to connect,
timeout, or -32700 parse error

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
ethrag ask --explain
which issue line?

span.p: uncited sentence

span.p: citation X was not retrieved

span.p:
unsupported claim T
not found in cited chunks

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
unbound claim T: found in the cited
chunks but never next to NAME

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
unit mismatch / range mismatch /
malformed range

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
negation in answer sentence N has no
negated source / negation dropped

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p: sentence N coverage x below 0.70

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
answer relevance / does not mention /
states no value / question names EIP-N

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
model reported
insufficient context

div.style: color: rgb(11, 42, 91) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center; width: 340px;

span.p:
Fix: the LLM ignored the citation format.
Retry, or drop --llm to use the extractive answerer.
Extractive answers are always cited.

div.style: color: rgb(11, 42, 91) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Fix: the draft cites a chunk outside the top-k.
ethrag ask -k 10 ...
or --rerank evals/artifacts/reranker.json

div.style: color: rgb(11, 42, 91) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center; width: 340px;

span.p:
Fix: the number or name is not in the cited text.
--explain shows the FAIL row. Re-ask naming the
EIP and constant, raise -k, check the doc exists:
ethrag related eip-N says unknown doc if not

div.style: color: rgb(11, 42, 91) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center; width: 340px;

span.p:
Fix: the value exists but belongs to another name,
so the draft is probably wrong. Re-ask with the exact
UPPER_SNAKE name; read the source line in --explain.

div.style: color: rgb(11, 42, 91) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Fix: the unit or range contradicts the source.
Quote the unit the spec uses (ETH vs gwei).
There is deliberately no flag to switch this off.

div.style: color: rgb(11, 42, 91) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center; width: 340px;

span.p:
Fix: a reversed claim. Re-ask, or inspect the source
sentence printed in the issue. Only for debugging:
--no-negation-check

div.style: color: rgb(11, 42, 91) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center; width: 340px;

span.p:
Fix: a paraphrase uses words the cited chunk lacks.
For LLM text try --min-coverage 0.5, or ask the
model to quote the spec.

div.style: color: rgb(11, 42, 91) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center; width: 340px;

span.p:
Fix: the answer is off-topic. Name the parameter or
EIP in the question; for debugging lower
--min-relevance, never to 0 in production.

div.style: color: rgb(11, 42, 91) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Fix: retrieval missed or the corpus lacks it.
See the recall branch below; ethrag stats
prints doc and chunk counts.

div.style: display: table; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Is the document
in the corpus?

div.style: color: rgb(11, 42, 91) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Fix: add it with scripts/fetch_corpus.py
--numbers N, then ethrag build-index

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Does the question name
EIP-N or the identifier?

div.style: color: rgb(11, 42, 91) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Fix: add EIP-N or the exact NAME.
Named EIPs get a rank boost

div.style: color: rgb(11, 42, 91) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Fix: raise -k, add --rerank
evals/artifacts/reranker.json (TEST R@5 0.934
vs 0.815), or --expand-graph for related EIPs

div.style: color: rgb(11, 42, 91) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Fix: ethrag build-index --data data --out .index
then ethrag ask --index .index ...
or set ETHRAG_INDEX

div.style: color: rgb(11, 42, 91) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center; width: 340px;

span.p:
Fix: pass --data DIR (markdown specs) or --index DIR.
A pip install without the repo has no data/ folder:
python scripts/fetch_corpus.py --out data

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p: Counts in the last line?

div.style: color: rgb(11, 42, 91) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Normal: most numbers in the curated list
do not exist. Nothing to fix.

div.style: color: rgb(11, 42, 91) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Fix: network. Only raw.githubusercontent.com
is needed. Set HTTPS_PROXY, test with
--dry-run, retry with --workers 2

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p: Which message?

div.style: color: rgb(11, 42, 91) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Fix: export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=...
or omit --llm

div.style: color: rgb(11, 42, 91) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p: Fix: pip install 'ethrag[llm]'

div.style: color: rgb(11, 42, 91) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Fix: ethrag serve --port 8081
or --port 0 for a random free port
(the chosen port is printed)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p: Which symptom?

div.style: color: rgb(11, 42, 91) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Fix: building the index takes seconds.
Run ethrag build-index once and start
ethrag mcp --index .index

div.style: color: rgb(11, 42, 91) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Fix: the transport is newline-delimited JSON
on stdin/stdout, not Content-Length framing.
Send one JSON object per line

div.style: color: rgb(11, 42, 91) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Fix: tools are ask_eips, search_eips,
related_eips. Arguments: question, query, doc
